conditions.name: Full NCNLP
conditions.note: The development runner executes compiled local DSL steps and public operations through the same evaluator. D34 qualification produced complete method, executor, and Oracle evidence; task failure remains an outcome rather than an infrastructure error.

conditions.name: Staged-LLM-Assign
conditions.changed_component: replace deterministic node assignment with an LLM assigner after fact recovery
conditions.note: The isolated LLM assignment hook preserves recovered facts and changes only node strategy assignment. Tests enforce fact preservation, and D34 records assignment parse failures as method outcomes.

conditions.name: Coarse M3
conditions.changed_component: merge fact recovery and node assignment into one model call
conditions.note: The joint condition performs fact recovery and node assignment in exactly one provider call after M2, while retaining the fixed classifier representation boundary and DSL compiler. D35 qualification preserved a strict schema violation as METHOD_ERROR instead of repairing it; this is a measured method outcome, not missing infrastructure.

conditions.name: w/o M0
conditions.changed_component: disable validation, repair, rejection and tracing as one package
conditions.note: The condition uses the same extractor once but disables decomposition retry, binding/program repair, rule fallback, pre-execution contract rejection, and M0 intervention tracing. Compiler language checks and experiment evidence remain. D35 compiled and executed N8F-063, exposing missing arguments as replay failures rather than repairing or rejecting them.

conditions.name: LLM-generated Python
conditions.changed_component: replace deterministic DSL-to-Python compilation with model-generated Python
conditions.note: A dedicated development runner replaces deterministic DSL-to-Python compilation with the existing llm_skeleton backend while holding the task, model, executor, evaluator, and repetitions fixed. D34 completed 2/2 executions; Oracle failures remain measured outcomes.

conditions.name: Rule-only M3
conditions.changed_component: replace model fact recovery with a frozen best-effort rule set
conditions.note: Uses the frozen deterministic fact-recovery rules without calling the LLM extractor. Missing bindings and DSL name-resolution failures are retained as method outcomes.

conditions.name: All-LLM boundary
conditions.changed_component: replace the full staged architecture with direct model execution
conditions.note: The dedicated development runner uses the Direct-LLM adapter with the same public input, model, executor, evaluator, and repetition count. D34 completed 2/2 executions and retained the observed Oracle outcomes.
